dimensions.name: Identity Risk
dimensions.construct: Potential for genomic information to enable persistent individual re-identification.

dimensions.name: Clinical Interpretation Risk
dimensions.construct: Potential for genomic information manipulation or disclosure to alter or reveal clinically relevant interpretation.
exclude: pipeline disruption with no demonstrated interpretation consequence

dimensions.name: Familial Cascade Risk
dimensions.construct: Extension of genomic exposure or inference from one individual to biological relatives.

dimensions.name: Accessibility Risk
dimensions.construct: Exposure associated with unauthorized, inappropriate, or insufficiently controlled genomic-data access.

dimensions.name: Persistence Risk
dimensions.construct: Difficulty of reversing genomic exposure or its consequences over time.

dimensions.name: Amplification Risk
dimensions.construct: Expansion of an initial genomic exposure through sharing, kinship, reuse, inference, or downstream propagation.

dimensions.name: Pipeline Exposure Risk
dimensions.construct: Propagation of a security-relevant integrity effect through genomic-processing stages.
exclude: isolated software failure without demonstrated downstream propagation
